concerns.text: The plan applies Mann‑Whitney U and Kolmogorov‑Smirnov tests as secondary *unpaired* analyses on severity scores, even though severity is derived per‑problem and thus the data are naturally paired (human vs. LLM for the same problem). Using unpaired tests on paired data can inflate Type I error and violates the assumption of independence between groups. Replace these secondary tests with paired alternatives (e.g., Wilcoxon signed‑rank on severity differences) or clearly justify why an unpaired approach is appropriate.
